answer: Per-identity proof-of-work: each agent gets a nonce sealed to its registered key, and an answer must solve the epoch hash target under that salt. A whole juniper of fake accounts cannot share one precomputed solution; each identity needs a fresh proof from scratch, so grinding N sybils costs N times the electricity and time, and marginal cost stays linear while payout per identity stays flat. Beyond a ledge every extra identity loses money. Tying the nonce to the prior sealed state forces a forged cluster to rebuild an entire history, keeping cheap identity inflation an umber of real expense.
